scope: This builder creates only two static reusable photo-referenced waste-bin variants. It does not modify the original five asset builders or runtime integration.
assumptions: Approximate scale and proportions; no ruler, brand, capacity or manufacturer identification.
Only visible front and top features are reconstructed. Closed-lid props do not assert hidden operating mechanics.
Small disposal pictograms are not legible enough to reproduce reliably and are omitted.
Grey and blue share construction with separate material variants. Chinese and English category text is mesh geometry.

render.visualInspection: Checked CPU previews; no browser acceptance
notes: Compared actual rendered pixels with the supplied photograph: tapered body, stepped lid shoulder, black liner band and recessed foot pedal are legible.
Resized Chinese and English labels by actual glyph width. The final labels are flat mesh print with no tiny or degenerate exported triangles.
Corrected local collar penetration through the black liner before final rendering.
Material colors and physical dimensions are approximate; preview uses neutral studio lighting. Small unreadable disposal pictograms are intentionally omitted.
